description: Sword and shield animation atlases for all four classes and armor appearances. Original transparent generation sources retained; exporter normalizes WebP frames.

generations.prompt: Production game sprite atlas, transparent background. Image1 is the approved Reaver identity, armor and painterly game style. Image2 demonstrates ONLY 4x4 layout, scale and pose range; DO NOT copy its two-handed weapon grip. Create a coherent SWORD AND SHIELD suite: a single modest straight steel arming sword in anatomical RIGHT hand, a round dark steel shield with brass rim strapped to anatomical LEFT forearm. Character faces screen-right in every fullbody slot, shield remains on same arm throughout. Exactly4columns4rows,15occupiedcells, lastcell empty. Row1: READY shieldfront sworddiagonal; ATK01 anticipation sworddrawnback shieldforward; ATK02 windup swordraisedbehindrightshoulder; ATK03 maximumwindup swordoverhead onehand. Row2: ATK04 downwardcut release; ATK05 impact sworddiagonaldownforward; ATK06 followthrough swordlowpasttarget; ATK07 recovery bringing swordup to ready. Row3: DEFEND shieldraisedcoverschest swordheldback; HURT recoiling with bothweaponsretained; CAST swordraisedwithsmallgoldaura shieldretained; aggressive stance swordpointforward shieldclose. Row4: defensive stance shieldforward swordlow; BUFF golden aura withbothweaponsretained; largebust PORTRAIT sameknight; EMPTY. Sameknighthelmet,batteredplate,burgundycape consistentallslots. Fullbody all14poses, feetaligned,equalfiguresize,generouscellpadding, no weapons crossingcellboundaries. Clear hands/grips, shieldneverbecomesaweaponheldbyswordhand, no extra limbs, no text orlabels orgrid orscenery. Output2048square.
